knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

```{r Library_import}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(immunedeconv)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r, include = FALSE }
wd <- params$wd
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = wd)
raw_path <- params$raw_path
metadata_path <- params$metadata_path
out_dir <- params$outdir
```


```{r data import}
setwd(wd)
data <- read.csv2(raw_path, row.names = 1)
metadata <- read.csv2(metadata_path,  sep = ",", row.names = 1)
```

```{r rearrange data for MCPCounter}

data$gene_name <- rownames(data)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(-c(gene_name), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

data <- data %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Convert df to matrix 
rownames(data) <- data$gene_name

data$gene_name <- NULL

data_mat <- as.matrix(data)
storage.mode(data_mat) <- "numeric"

```

```{r Deconvolution}
setwd(paste0(wd,out_dir))

# MCP-counter estimates the relative abundance of 10 immune and stromal cell populations (T cells, CD8 T cells, NK cells, B lineage, monocytic lineage,myeloid dendritic cells, neutrophils, endothelial cells, fibroblasts) from bulk gene expression data.

# Run deconvolution with MCP-counter via the immunedeconv wrapper
deconv_result <- immunedeconv::deconvolute(data_mat, "mcp_counter")


if (!dir.exists("3_deconvolution")) {
  dir.create("3_deconvolution")
}

# Export the deconvolution results
write.csv2(deconv_result, "3_deconvolution/deconv_results.csv",
           row.names = FALSE)


# Add deconv results to metadata
deconv_result_transposed <- deconv_result %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cell_type, names_to = "Sample.ID", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = Value)


colnames(metadata)[1] <- "Sample.ID"
metadata <- metadata[,-2]

metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(deconv_result_transposed, by = "Sample.ID")

write.csv2(metadata, "3_deconvolution/metadata_deconv.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
```{Plot results}
setwd(paste0(wd,out_dir))

# log2 transform for better visualization
deconv_result_log <- deconv_result_transposed %>%
  mutate(across(-Sample.ID, ~ log2(.x + 1)))

# Add molecular class from metadata 
metadata_short <- metadata %>% 
  dplyr::select(Sample.ID, Sarcomatoid, Histological_subtype, MIBC_classif, patient)

deconv_result_log <- deconv_result_log %>%
  left_join(metadata_short, by = "Sample.ID")

# 2. Nettoyage et préparation des données
plot_data <- deconv_result_log %>%
  filter(!is.na(MIBC_classif)) %>%
  mutate(MIBC_classif = factor(MIBC_classif)

cell_types <- c("T cell","T cell CD8+","cytotoxicity score","NK cell","B cell","Monocyte","Macrophage/Monocyte","Myeloid dendritic cell","Neutrophil","Endothelial cell","Cancer associated fibroblast")

for(cell_type in cell_types){
  sarc <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Sarcomatoid == "Sarcomatoid") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, !!paste0(cell_type,"_sarc") := !!sym(cell_type))
  
  nonsarc <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Sarcomatoid == "Non Sarcomatoid") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, !!paste0(cell_type,"_non") := !!sym(cell_type))
  
  pairs <- inner_join(sarc, nonsarc, by = "patient") %>%
    mutate(link_id = row_number())   

  pairs_long <- pairs %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(paste0(cell_type,"_sarc"), paste0(cell_type,"_non")),
      names_to = "Sarcomatoid",
      values_to = cell_type
    ) %>%
    mutate(Histological_subtype = recode(Sarcomatoid,
                                         !!paste0(cell_type,"_sarc") := "Sarcomatoid",
                                         !!paste0(cell_type,"_non")  := "Non Sarcomatoid"))
}





# for each MCP-counter cell type, build a paired boxplot (Sarcomatoid vs Non Sarcomatoid) with a Wilcoxon test, and store each plot in a named list for later display/export

cell_types <- c("T cell","T cell CD8+","cytotoxicity score","NK cell","B cell","Monocyte",
                "Macrophage/Monocyte","Myeloid dendritic cell","Neutrophil",
                "Endothelial cell","Cancer associated fibroblast")

plots_list <- list()

for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  
  # Split the data into Sarcomatoid vs Non Sarcomatoid, keeping only the columns needed (patient ID, cell-type score and the MIBC class)
  sarc <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Sarcomatoid == "Sarcomatoid") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, sarc_val = !!sym(cell_type), MIBC_classif)
  
  nonsarc <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Sarcomatoid == "Non Sarcomatoid") %>%
    dplyr::select(patient, non_val = !!sym(cell_type))
  
  # assign a unique ID to plot paired boxplot latter
  pairs <- inner_join(sarc, nonsarc, by = "patient") %>%
    mutate(link_id = row_number())
  
  # Reshape to long format for ggplot
  pairs_long <- pairs %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(sarc_val, non_val),
      names_to = "Sarcomatoid",
      values_to = "score"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Sarcomatoid = ifelse(Sarcomatoid == "sarc_val", "Sarcomatoid", "NonSarcomatoid"))
  
  # Build the paired boxplot
  p <- ggplot(pairs_long, aes(x = Sarcomatoid, y = score, fill = Sarcomatoid)) + 
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line(aes(group = link_id), color = "black", alpha = 0.3) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Sarcomatoid" = "palegreen", 
                                 "NonSarcomatoid" = "royalblue")) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("NonSarcomatoid", "Sarcomatoid")),
                       method = "wilcox.test",
                       label = "p.signif",
                       bracket.size = 0.3) + 
    theme_minimal() + 
    labs(
      title = cell_type,
      x = "",
      y = "Abundance score",
      legend = "Histological subtype"
    ) + 
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12, angle = 30, hjust = 1), 
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("NonSarcomatoid" = "Non SARC",  
                                "Sarcomatoid"    = "SARC")) 
  
  # Store the plot in a list with labels = cell types 
  plots_list[[cell_type]] <- p
}


plots_list[["Monocyte"]] # Plot for given cell-type

# Combine all plots 
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots_list, ncol = 3)
print(combined_plot)

ggsave("3_deconvolution/all_celltypes_boxplots.png",
       plot = combined_plot,width = 15, height = 15, dpi = 300)

```
